question: On what basis do those in the world classify certain beings as beasts lacking knowledge?
premises: A conventional claim is made in the world.
Certain beings are designated as beasts.
Those beings are characterized as devoid of knowledge.
inference: Beast-status is assigned by convention to beings devoid of knowledge.
uncertainties: Whether the claim is conventional or ontological is not specified.
plain_english: In the world they say that beasts, devoid of knowledge, are so designated.
